list_search_placeholder: Search customers by email, name or phone
list_empty_description: Checkout adds a customer for each new email; they show up here.
list_no_results_description: Search looks at emails, names and phones.
edit_subtitle: What the shop knows about them. Orders keep the details they were placed with.
delete_description: The customer, their addresses and custom field values go for good. Their open carts stay, without a customer.
erase_dialog_description: After the cancel window, their name, contact details, addresses, notes and consent are removed from the customer and their orders, carts and emails. Orders, totals and countries stay. Apps are told to delete their copies. This can't be undone once it runs.
erased_banner_title: This customer's personal data was erased
erased_banner_description: On {time}. What stays: their orders' statistics, their groups and a placeholder email that can't receive mail. The customer is read-only.
erasure_banner_description: Their personal data is removed on {time}. Until then it can be cancelled.
account_never: Never signed in to the storefront. Checkouts as a guest still count as this customer.
account_devices: {count, plural, =0 {No devices} one {# device} other {# devices}}
note_missing_description: Keep what staff should know about a customer here. It's a personal custom field: hidden from roles without {scope}, and erased with them.
note_placeholder: What staff should know about this customer.
labels_dialog_subtitle: Words to find this customer by again. Type a new one, or pick one in use.
well_known_not_offered: The API doesn't offer this field.
well_known_exists: A field {field} exists already, with another shape. Find it under Settings → Custom fields.
groups_page_description: Named sets of customers with a stable ID: what group prices and payment methods will point at. Labels are for finding customers; groups are for rules.
groups_description: Sets of customers that prices and payment methods can refer to. A customer can be in any number of them.
groups_empty_description: Add one, then put customers in it from their pages or the customers list.
groups_dialog_incomplete: A group needs a name and a handle.
groups_dialog_subtitle: The handle names the group to apps and in URLs; it changes nothing for customers.
groups_dialog_handle_description: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes; unique among groups.
groups_delete_description: Its customers leave the group and stay customers. Anything pointing at the group stops working.
groups_card_description: Sets that prices and payment methods can refer to. <link>Manage groups</link>
consent_description: Whether the customer agreed to news and offers. The newest consent wins, so a late sync can't undo a newer opt-out.
consent_not_applied: A newer consent is stored for this channel; nothing changed.
consent_dialog_subtitle: Recorded as given now, by you. A customer's own choice at checkout or through an app carries its own time.
consent_dialog_level_single: Single opt-in (ticked a box, said so)
addresses_empty: No saved addresses. Checkout keeps an order's address on the order.
addresses_dialog_subtitle: For the address book. Orders keep the address they were placed with.
addresses_delete_description: {address} leaves the address book. Orders placed with it keep it.
